steps.name: benchmark-harness
steps.summary: Added benchmarks/ package (__init__.py, common.py with gateway_client/run_concurrent/percentiles/histogram_percentiles_from_metrics_text/BenchmarkResult/write_result/print_summary, thresholds.py's 8 named constants, conftest.py's db_pool/benchmark_team fixtures mirroring tests/conftest.py against gateway.db, test_common.py + test_thresholds.py unit tests) plus pyproject.toml's [tool.pytest.ini_options] (benchmark marker + addopts = "-m 'not benchmark'") and .gitignore's benchmarks/results/ entry; verified addopts leaves the existing 225-test suite's pass count unchanged (231 total with the 6 new plain unit tests) and that a @pytest.mark.benchmark test is excluded by default but selected via -m benchmark.

steps.name: gateway-overhead-metric
steps.summary: Added gateway_overhead_seconds histogram (metrics.py) observed in routes.py's two success branches only (non-streaming, right after call_with_resilience; streaming, right after resolve_streaming_start) as max(0.0, (now - request_started) - elapsed), with request_started captured at the very top of create_chat_completion; extended tests/test_metrics.py with a count/sum before-after test; added benchmarks/bench_overhead.py (concurrency=5, 200 requests after 10 warmup, against a fast gpt-4o-mini mock model over real HTTP) which snapshots /metrics before and after its own load and diffs each histogram bucket to isolate this run's own observations from the process-lifetime-cumulative metric (a long-lived container's history otherwise pollutes any single post-load snapshot), then asserts p95 against thresholds.OVERHEAD_P95_MS (20ms) -- measured p50 ~7-18ms, p95 ~13-18ms, p99 ~24-38ms across repeated runs, passing. Full suite: 232 passed.

steps.name: throughput-benchmark
steps.summary: Added benchmarks/bench_throughput.py's test_sustained_throughput (module docstring explicitly distinguishes it from tests/load/locustfile.py's OS-level 5,000+ concurrent-user Locust load test, not a substitute for TRD §10) using run_concurrent(..., duration_seconds=...) in sustained-load mode, concurrency and duration overridable via PLEXON_BENCHMARK_CONCURRENCY/PLEXON_BENCHMARK_DURATION_SECONDS env vars (small smoke defaults: concurrency=10, duration=5s), achieved_rps computed against actual measured wall-clock time (not the requested duration_seconds); no new rpm/tpm/budget values introduced -- step 0's benchmark_team fixture headroom was already generous enough. Default smoke run measured ~77 RPS / 0 errors against thresholds.THROUGHPUT_MIN_RPS (50 RPS), passing. Full suite: 232 passed.
